svg.title: A triangle switches sides at a negative triple passage
svg.desc: Three magnified stills at weights 0.4641, approximately 0.464144224361, and 0.4642. Two downward-traveled outer branches and an upward-traveled halfway branch form a little clockwise triangle before meeting. A counterclockwise triangle opens on the other side. Its winding count changes from minus one to plus two, while strangeness changes from zero to minus one.

g.text: Three branches keep moving. Their little triangle turns through one negative triple meeting.
Blue and gold: the earlier and later visits. White: the halfway visit. Arrows follow travel.
Every panel uses the same equal scales: 0.012 units from the horizontal axis to the window’s top.
All crossings belong to these three branches throughout 0.4641 ≤ a ≤ 0.4642.
Rounded numerical geometry; exact rational family cover, endpoint words, and invariant values are checked separately.
